correctness.description: Test `test_mattermost_report_posted` passes: Verify that a duplicate detection report was posted to Mattermost.
Test `test_duplicates_correctly_identified` passes: Verify that all duplicates are correctly identified and reported.
Test `test_report_format_correct` passes: Verify that the report message is formatted correctly.

functional.description: The solution uses the EspoCRM API endpoint 'http://localhost:80' (or 'http://espocrm:80')
functional.rationale: Ensures the solution connects to the correct EspoCRM instance

functional.description: The solution uses the Mattermost API endpoint 'http://localhost:8065' (or 'http://mattermost:8065')
functional.rationale: Ensures the solution connects to the correct Mattermost instance

functional.description: The solution authenticates with both EspoCRM and Mattermost using the required credentials
functional.rationale: Authentication is required for API access

functional.description: The solution identifies contacts with identical email addresses and reports them
functional.rationale: Duplicate detection logic is the core functional requirement.

robustness.description: The solution verifies that the 'data-quality' channel exists in Mattermost, or handles its absence
robustness.rationale: Prevents posting failures if the target channel is missing.

robustness.description: The solution handles cases where no duplicates are found by sending a 'no duplicates' message or exiting cleanly
robustness.rationale: Provides clarity on system status when data is clean.

robustness.description: The solution normalizes email addresses (e.g., trimming whitespace) before comparing for duplicates
robustness.rationale: Ensures accurate duplicate detection despite data entry errors.

robustness.description: The solution handles API errors from either service gracefully
robustness.rationale: Prevents crashes if one service is unavailable.
